import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Sales by Product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_product = sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_sales))
product_sales.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors_product)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(v, i, f' ${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales_ordered = age_sales.reindex([x for x in age_order if x in age_sales.index])
colors_age = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(age_sales_ordered))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales_ordered.values, 
                                     labels=age_sales_ordered.index,
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=colors_age,
                                     startangle=90,
                                     textprops={'fontsize': 10})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 3. Payment Method Usage
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors_payment = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(payment_counts))
bars = ax3.bar(range(len(payment_counts)), payment_counts.values, color=colors_payment, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(payment_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(payment_counts.index, rotation=0, fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Transaction Count by Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{int(height)}',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Average Order Value by Size and Takeaway Status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
size_takeaway = df.groupby(['size', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].mean().reset_index()
size_takeaway['takeaway_label'] = size_takeaway['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'})
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
pivot_data = size_takeaway.pivot(index='size', columns='takeaway_label', values='total')
pivot_data = pivot_data.reindex([x for x in size_order if x in pivot_data.index])

x = np.arange(len(pivot_data.index))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax4.bar(x - width/2, pivot_data['Dine-in'], width, label='Dine-in', color='#FF6B6B', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1)
bars2 = ax4.bar(x + width/2, pivot_data['Takeaway'], width, label='Takeaway', color='#4ECDC4', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1)

ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Order Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Average Order Value by Size and Order Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(pivot_data.index)
ax4.legend(frameon=True, shadow=True, fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                 f'${height:.2f}',
                 ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
